items.source:
Set the accumulate ScriptOperators.Function that updates the state for each document. The functions first argument is the current state, additional arguments can be defined via accumulateArgs.
function(state, accumArg1, accumArg2, ...) { ... return newState }
items.translation:
设置一个用于更新每个文档状态的 `accumulate` ScriptOperators.Function。该函数的第一个参数是当前state，其他参数可以通过accumulateArgs定义。
function(state, accumArg1, accumArg2, ...) { ... return newState }

function(state, accumArg1, accumArg2, ...) { ... return newState }
